$comment: What one billable unit costs Krizaka, against the credit rate the billing pricebook (krizaka-billing, v2) charges for it. Read by tests/pricing-margin.test.mjs. Money in millicents of CAD (1000 = 1 cent), the pricebook's own anchor (ADR-047). `assumption: true` marks a figure not yet measured on a real run: it is replaced by the recorded cost of the run that measures it. The billing service's pricebook remains the source of truth for rates; this file is the default the margin guard checks.

processor.source: https://stripe.com/en-ca/pricing (domestic cards, read 2026-10-31); +0.8 % international cards, +2 % conversion not included

rates.source: Wan 2.2 A14B I2V at cinema settings on an H100 80 GB (RunPod CA-MTL-1, 3.99 USD/h, krizaka-internal#138): about 20 GPU minutes per 5 s shot, plus 25 % warm-up and the 4K upscale

measured: 26 key frames for 1.57 USD on an H100 80 GB, warm-up included (krizaka-internal#138, 2026-10-31); 2.09 MP x 4 steps per frame assumed
local model on Krizaka's own node, hosting share; a cloud-routed model needs its own row priced from its provider's rate
